name: search_brands
title: Search Franchise Brands Catalog
description: FREE. Search and discover indexed restaurant brands across the 500 US franchise database by name, concept, sector, or category. Returns matching chains with total unit counts, category classification, and per-call endpoint pricing. Read-only operation requiring no API key or balance. Rate limit: 60 req/min. WHEN TO USE: Use first when discovering brand slugs or verifying if a chain is indexed in the catalog. WHEN NOT TO USE: Do not use for physical store locations (use 'franchise_search_near' or 'mcdonalds_locations'), corporate filings (use 'get_fdd_item19'), or natural language vector searches (use 'semantic_vector_search'). ALTERNATIVES: Use 'semantic_vector_search' for conceptual similarity; use 'describe_endpoint' to inspect route pricing.

query.description: Case-insensitive search query matching brand name, category, or slug (e.g. 'burger', 'coffee', 'taco', 'subway'). If omitted, returns top brands ordered by fleet size.

brands.description: List of matching brand summaries with fleet size and API prices

name: describe_endpoint
title: Describe Endpoint Schema and Pricing
description: FREE. Inspect technical documentation, supported query parameters, authentication methods, and per-call pricing for any REST API route on franchisedata.io. Read-only operation requiring no API key or balance. Rate limit: 60 req/min. Returns 404 if the endpoint route is unrecognized. WHEN TO USE: Use before calling 'fetch_franchise_data' to verify required query parameters, authentication headers, and per-request prices. WHEN NOT TO USE: Do not use to fetch actual brand data records; use 'fetch_franchise_data' or specialized shortcut tools instead. ALTERNATIVES: Use 'search_brands' to discover brand slugs; use 'fetch_franchise_data' to execute the request.

endpoint.description: Target REST API path to inspect (e.g. '/api/brands/mcdonalds/locations', '/api/brands/tacobell/operators').

name: check_balance
title: Check API Credit Balance
description: FREE. Query the remaining prepaid credit balance (in USD and micro-USD) and active status for a FranchiseData Pro API key. Read-only operation requiring an API key passed via 'api_key' argument or 'Authorization: Bearer fc_live_...' header. Returns 400 if key is omitted, or 401 if key is invalid. WHEN TO USE: Use before executing batch paid queries to verify sufficient funds remain. WHEN NOT TO USE: Do not use for minting new keys or topping up funds; use 'topup_credits' instead. ALTERNATIVES: Use 'topup_credits' to deposit credits or create new credentials.

api_key.description: Optional if Authorization HTTP header is set. The 'fc_live_...' API key to inspect.

is_active.description: Whether the API key is active

name: topup_credits
title: Mint API Key or Top Up Prepaid Credits
description: Deposit prepaid credits into an existing API key or mint a new key ($1.00 USD minimum, $500.00 max). State-mutating operation that creates or updates database credentials. Requires no prior authentication. Pass 'api_key' to top up an existing key, or omit 'api_key' to mint a fresh key. Returns generated or updated key details and balance in USD. WHEN TO USE: Use when an existing key has exhausted credits, or when a new agent session requires dedicated credentials. WHEN NOT TO USE: Do not use solely to inspect an existing balance without depositing funds; use 'check_balance' instead. ALTERNATIVES: Use 'check_balance' for read-only balance verification without adding credits.

amount_usd.description: Amount to deposit in USD (minimum 1.00, maximum 500.00, e.g. 5.00).

api_key.description: Optional existing 'fc_live_...' key to top up. If omitted, mints and returns a fresh API key.

key.description: The newly minted API key (only present when creating a new key)

name: fetch_franchise_data
title: Universal Franchise REST Endpoint Runner
description: PAID ($0.002 - $0.005). Execute parameterized REST queries against any franchisedata.io API endpoint with typed arguments. Atomically debits balance per request. Requires 'fc_live_...' API key with sufficient balance. Returns 402 if balance is insufficient. WHEN TO USE: Use ONLY as an escape hatch for arbitrary or custom REST routes not covered by typed shortcut tools. WHEN NOT TO USE: Do not use when a dedicated typed tool exists (e.g. use 'get_fdd_item19' for FDD unit economics, 'detect_tech_stack' for POS hardware, 'get_operator_intelligence' for ownership trees, 'mcdonalds_locations' for McDonald's stores). ALTERNATIVES: Use 'describe_endpoint' first to verify route parameters; use specialized shortcuts for validated schemas.

params.description: Key-value map of URL query parameters (e.g. { 'state': 'CA', 'drive_thru': 'true', 'limit': 10 }).

api_key.description: Optional if Authorization header is set. Your 'fc_live_...' API key.

data.description: Array of returned record rows from the database

balance_remaining_usd.description: Remaining API credit balance in USD

name: mcdonalds_locations
title: Query McDonald's Store Locations
description: PAID ($0.003). Dedicated fast search for McDonald's fleet stores filtered by city, state, postal zip code, and drive-thru availability. Atomically debits $0.003 from prepaid balance. Requires 'fc_live_...' API key. Returns 402 if balance is insufficient. WHEN TO USE: Use specifically when looking up McDonald's store locations and filtering for drive-thru lanes. WHEN NOT TO USE: Do not use for other chains or cross-brand searches; use 'franchise_search_near' instead. ALTERNATIVES: Use 'franchise_search_near' for coordinate-based cross-brand proximity search; use 'search_brands' to discover other chains.

city.description: City name to filter stores by (e.g. 'Chicago', 'Dallas')

drive_thru.description: Filter exclusively for stores with verified drive-thru lanes

limit.description: Maximum number of store records to return (default 25, max 50)

balance_remaining_usd.description: Remaining API credit balance in USD

locations.description: List of McDonald's store records matching filters

name: starbucks_store_status
title: Real-Time Starbucks Operating Status
description: PAID ($0.002). Retrieve live operating status, weekly schedule, and current open/closed state for a specific Starbucks store. Atomically debits $0.002 from prepaid balance. Requires 'fc_live_...' API key. If 'store_id' is omitted, defaults to the first indexed store. Returns 404 if store is not found, 402 if balance insufficient. WHEN TO USE: Use to verify whether an individual Starbucks store is currently open or to view its operating schedule. WHEN NOT TO USE: Do not use for fleet-wide location discovery (use 'franchise_search_near' or 'fetch_franchise_data'). ALTERNATIVES: Use 'franchise_search_near' for finding open stores near coordinates; use 'track_brand_changes' for permanent closures.

store_id.description: Optional Starbucks store identifier or store number (e.g. '1033083', 'loc_starbucks_1033083'). If omitted, inspects the first indexed store.

hours.description: Weekly operating hours by daypart and weekday

name: franchise_search_near
title: Radial Cross-Brand Location Proximity Search
description: PAID ($0.005). Radial coordinate-based proximity search (up to 50 miles) across all 500 US restaurant franchise chains. Returns geocoded locations, distance, and brand classification. Atomically debits $0.005 from prepaid balance. Requires 'fc_live_...' API key. Returns 402 if balance is insufficient. WHEN TO USE: Use for geographic competitive landscape queries, local market density analysis, and finding nearby restaurants across multiple brands. WHEN NOT TO USE: Do not use for single-brand McDonald's lookups by city/zip (use 'mcdonalds_locations') or brand catalog metadata (use 'search_brands'). ALTERNATIVES: Use 'mcdonalds_locations' for dedicated McDonald's filters; use 'get_local_share_of_choice' for delivery shelf share.

lat.description: Center latitude coordinate in decimal degrees (e.g. 41.8781)

lng.description: Center longitude coordinate in decimal degrees (e.g. -87.6298)

store_id.description: Store ID (e.g. 'loc_tacobell_1001') to look up controlling franchisee.

name: semantic_vector_search
title: pgvector Semantic Embeddings Search
description: PAID ($0.005). Perform high-dimensional cosine similarity semantic vector search across multi-unit operators and menu items using embeddings. Atomically debits $0.005. Requires 'fc_live_...' API key. Type defaults to 'operators' if omitted. 'brand' parameter is only applied when type is 'menu'. Returns 402 if balance insufficient. WHEN TO USE: Use for conceptual natural language queries (e.g. 'private equity franchisee groups in Texas' or 'spicy chicken breakfast sandwich'). WHEN NOT TO USE: Do not use for exact brand catalog keyword searches (use 'search_brands') or coordinate proximity searches (use 'franchise_search_near'). ALTERNATIVES: Use 'search_brands' for keyword catalog matching; use 'get_menu_pricing' for exact store menu lookups.

query.description: Natural language query describing desired operator profile or menu concept (e.g. 'Flynn Restaurant Group Applebees', 'spicy chicken sandwich')

type.description: Vector index target: 'operators' for ownership entities (default) or 'menu' for food items

brand.description: Optional canonical brand slug to constrain menu search (e.g. 'mcdonalds', 'chickfila'). Only used when type is 'menu'.

limit.description: Maximum number of nearest-neighbor results to return (default 5, max 20)

results.description: Nearest-neighbor vector search matches with similarity scores
